service_description: Provides programmatic search and filtering capabilities for the database of Y Combinator companies.

tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Searches for Y Combinator companies using keywords, filters, and facets. Use this to find companies based on names, industries, batches, or tags.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: The search term (e.g., company name or keywords).

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Algolia filter string. Fields include batch, industry, status, regions, isHiring, tags. Quote values with spaces, e.g. 'batch:"Winter 2025"' or 'industry:Fintech AND status:Active AND isHiring:true'.

parameters.name: facets
parameters.description: Attributes to count results by, e.g. ["batch", "industry", "status"].

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The page number to retrieve for paginated results.

static_query.x-algolia-agent: Algolia for JavaScript (3.35.1); Browser; JS Helper (3.16.1)
